response.overview: This film serves as a sobering cautionary tale regarding workplace safety, emphasizing that industrial accidents are rarely the result of equipment failure alone, but rather the consequence of human thoughtlessness and lapses in concentration. Through graphic testimonials and interviews with victims who have suffered life-altering injuries—including amputations and permanent disability—the film illustrates the long-term physical, emotional, and economic devastation that follows a split-second mistake. While highlighting the importance of personal protective equipment and rigorous safety protocols, the narrative ultimately argues that machinery is only as safe as the person operating it. It concludes with a powerful appeal to workers to remain perpetually vigilant, asserting that the only defense against the inherent dangers of the workplace is a constant, proactive commitment to safety-conscious thinking.
response.title: Don't Take Chances
